claims.text: On web, data-cs-override-id provides a stable tracking identity used by the tag's interaction collection and zoning.
Classic trackPageEvent / event accepts a name only; no properties.
Product Analytics trackEvent accepts a name and optional properties; customProperties:visit:add attaches properties to subsequent events.
On iOS, accessibilityIdentifier is the primary reliable target for zoning.
On Android, CSQ.setAreaIdentifier / csqAreaIdentifier assigns a reliable zone identifier.
Mapping a Canon notation into data-cs-override-id (web) or the platform reliable identifier (mobile) gives one stable identity across surfaces.
